detail.longDescription: Checking in from the # research bunker! ☀️ I've been coding to launch our VVNB online store. I can't wait to share this project showcasing vintage goods, vinyl records, & # books ! 📚 Outside my window, the bird crew is out, chirping in the sunshine. Big Pop, the chief Northern Cardinal, has gone temporarily AWOL. Gemini assures me he's alive and just sitting out the “molting” season in denser trees. His feathers fall off, and then a new bright red feathered winter coat finishes coming in. OUCH!! ❤️‍🩹
